rationale: Shiza is building Haptile at the intersection of robotics, haptics, and applied ML, while Sophy brings infrastructure and full-stack engineering expertise in Python and JavaScript from her work at HubSpot. As Shiza scales from mechanical engineering into deployment-focused robotics, Sophy's background in infrastructure and developer tools could help bridge the gap between research prototypes and production systems—a gap Shiza explicitly identifies as requiring different skill sets than pure robotics research.
intro_message: Shiza Charania, meet Sophy Sun — you're both Toronto-based engineers working across ML and infrastructure, and Sophy's experience shipping production systems at scale could complement Haptile's journey from prototype to deployed robotics.
